lane: B1: TA-learned copy selector at full data (docs/13 A4 H9.1, H9.2; gate G1 T2)
status: CONFIRMATORY verdicts over seeds 1, 2, 3 of experiments/cvtm/configs/cvtm_copy_selector_H9.json; this file only lists the seed runs; every rule is the H9 config's. The seed runs were first listed while the 2026-09-24 runs ran; those were stopped (an infrastructure interruption and a mem_guard limit that had been set too low), and on 2026-09-25 about 07:00 UTC the list was pointed at the completed relaunch of 2026-09-25 00:00 UTC, AFTER those runs' logged validation rows (TM, C0, LR, LR2, HGB) had been read. No rule, threshold or control changed, so the verdict is a mechanical reading of the registered H9 rules; validation only, the test split is never loaded

hypotheses.H9.1: validation bits per byte of core + TM at least 0.010 below the CVTM-core (1.240880320113308) on every seed, document-bootstrap 95 percent CI of the difference excluding 0
hypotheses.H9.2: docs/13 A4 with A5 D0.2: per seed the best control (of LR, LR2, HGB, C0) is the one with the lowest S2b held-out bits per position (residue 2 of H', never validation); the verdict uses the 3-seed mean of (TM minus best control) with a paired document bootstrap over the 60 validation documents: at most -0.002 with the CI excluding 0 = beats; at most 0.000 = matches; otherwise trails. A control fit still at its raised iteration cap blocks 'beats'. Per-seed readings and TM minus each control are reported alongside
hypotheses.TM_minus_C0: docs/13 A5 D0.2: reported as its own row (3-seed mean, paired document bootstrap; per seed)
hypotheses.G1_T2: docs/13 A4 with the A5 D0.1 bands: A = every seed gains >= 0.010 with its CI excluding 0 -> open H9.3; B = every seed >= 0.005 with its CI excluding 0 and not A -> keep the row, H9.3 as a 5M pilot only; C = otherwise -> no T2 engine work. The smallest per-seed gain decides; the seed mean is reported
hypotheses.D0_3_credit: docs/13 A5 D0.3: band A AND TM minus C0 (3-seed mean) at most -0.005 bits per byte with the CI excluding 0

statistics: document-block bootstrap over the 60 validation documents, 2,000 resamples, tmlm.cvtm.protocol.BOOT_SEED, ratio of summed bits to summed bytes per resample; labelled derived
launch: scripts/cpu_slot.sh 1 -- nice -n 10 .venv-tm/bin/python scripts/mem_guard.py -- scripts/run_logged.py --no-gpu-sampler --name cvtm_copy_selector_H9_verdicts --config experiments/cvtm/configs/cvtm_copy_selector_H9_verdicts.json -- .venv-tm/bin/python -u experiments/cvtm_copy_selector.py verdicts --config experiments/cvtm/configs/cvtm_copy_selector_H9_verdicts.json
